title: Approvals
description: Human decisions required before a risky tool action proceeds.

card.paramsUnavailable: The action's invocation parameters aren't returned by GET /approvals or GET /approvals/:id — manar-api's ApprovalRequestSummaryDto only exposes tool/action/resource/risk metadata, not the params payload. Shown here would be fabricated, so this section is intentionally left honest instead.
card.explanationUnavailable: manar-api doesn't currently return a structured "reason approval was required" (e.g. which policy rule or ToolAction default triggered it) on this endpoint — only the resulting risk score. A future phase surfacing RiskEngine's explanation would let this section show the real reason instead of the risk score alone.

decide.reasonPlaceholder: Add context for the audit trail
decide.submittedToast: Decision submitted — the status above updates automatically once it's applied.
decide.alreadyDecided: This request was already decided — by another approver, another tab, or it expired — before your decision reached manar-api. No double-decision was made.
decide.pendingNote: The decision endpoint signals the running approval workflow and returns immediately — the status above updates automatically once the workflow finishes applying it (usually within a couple seconds).

detail.notFoundBody: No approval request with this ID was found in this workspace's approvals list.
